patterns.name: Centered typography hero
patterns.description: Monumental headline centered horizontally with restrained subtext and primary CTA cluster. Symmetrical balance with generous breathing room.
patterns.responsive_behavior: Desktop: 1200px container with text-center; Mobile: scales font-size via clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5.5rem), buttons wrap to 100% width vertical stack.
patterns.code_snippet:
Announcement

Precision Engineering for Modern Web Products

Experience unmatched digital craft, deterministic design tokens, and fluid motion physics built for high-scale teams.
patterns.accessibility_notes: Ensures H1 is the primary semantic landmark; visible focus-visible on all buttons.

patterns.name: Split-screen text and image hero
patterns.description: 50/50 two-column asymmetrical lockup with narrative copy on left and interactive visual asset or product frame on right.
patterns.responsive_behavior: Desktop: 2-column grid 1fr 1fr; Tablet & Mobile: single column stack with text positioned above visual.
patterns.code_snippet:
The Next Dimension of User Experience

Built from first principles. Complete control over lighting, depth, and spatial interactions in your browser.

Deploy Now Interactive Demo
patterns.accessibility_notes: Image requires informative alt text; logical source DOM order keeps copy before media for screen readers.

patterns.name: Asymmetric editorial hero
patterns.description: Unconventional rhythm with offset headline, micro-eyebrow metadata column, and overlapping visual plane.
patterns.responsive_behavior: Desktop: 12-column grid where title spans cols 1-8, metadata in cols 9-12, and hero image offsets across cols 4-12; Mobile: linear stack with preserved hierarchy.
patterns.code_snippet:
VOL. 04 / 2026

Independent studio focusing on digital craft and spatial ergonomics.

Sculpting Void & Form in Modern Architecture
patterns.accessibility_notes: Grid columns reflow to single column under 860px; preserve tab flow across editorial markers.

patterns.name: Full-screen immersive hero
patterns.description: 100vh / 100dvh viewport container with edge-to-edge media backdrop, subtle dark overlay, and bottom-anchored headline.
patterns.responsive_behavior: Uses min-height: 100dvh; content anchored via align-self: flex-end; mobile ensures safe-area-inset padding.
patterns.code_snippet:
Excellence in Motion

Beyond the Horizon

Discover uncharted soundscapes and cinematic direction.
patterns.accessibility_notes: WCAG 2.2 AA contrast verified by 85% opacity dark scrim overlay beneath white typography.

patterns.name: Video-background hero
patterns.description: HTML5 muted ambient video loop playing smoothly behind high-contrast typography with instant pause control.
patterns.responsive_behavior: Covers background via object-fit: cover; mobile provides poster fallback for data savings and pauses video if battery saving is active.
patterns.code_snippet:
Motion That Inspires

A visual showcase of next-generation physical interfaces.
patterns.accessibility_notes: Video must be muted and loop without audio track; prefers-reduced-motion hides video and shows static poster.

patterns.name: Interactive 3D hero
patterns.description: WebGL interactive canvas (Three.js / Spline) integrated with non-blocking HTML UI overlay.
patterns.responsive_behavior: Desktop: canvas spans background, text in left column with pointer-events: none on wrapper and auto on interactive buttons; Mobile: reduces geometry complexity or falls back to static rendering.
patterns.code_snippet:
Spatial Computing

Interact with Hardware in Real Time

Drag to inspect the architectural chassis from any angle.
patterns.accessibility_notes: Canvas marked aria-hidden='true'; all clickable actions remain in native accessible DOM with full tab stops.

patterns.name: Large typography-led hero
patterns.description: Ultra-large headline font taking up 70% of viewport area. Minimal supporting elements; typography as pure art.
patterns.responsive_behavior: Scales using clamp(3.5rem, 12vw, 11rem); words hyphenate-limit-chars or fit viewport without overflow.
patterns.code_snippet:
RADICAL
SIMPLICITY

01 / PHILOSOPHY INDEX 2026 SCROLL TO READ
patterns.accessibility_notes: Ensures huge font sizes do not create horizontal scrollbars on 320px mobile screens.

patterns.name: Image-overlapping hero
patterns.description: Headline and supporting cards physically overlap hero imagery using negative margins or CSS Grid overlap cells.
patterns.responsive_behavior: Desktop: Grid grid-row overlaps; Mobile: transforms into linear flow to avoid obscuring text.
patterns.code_snippet:
Exclusive Project

Villa Sanctuaries

Crafted amidst the Mediterranean cliffs with zero visual noise.

Explore Property →
patterns.accessibility_notes: Maintains card contrast against image; drops negative margin on mobile if needed.

patterns.name: Layered parallax hero
patterns.description: Multiple scenic depth planes (background mountains, midground trees, foreground mist) that translate at different speeds.
patterns.responsive_behavior: Uses CSS transform translate3d with requestAnimationFrame; falls back to static layer stack if reduced-motion is requested.
patterns.code_snippet:
Ascend Beyond Limits

High-altitude technical apparel for severe alpine summits.
patterns.accessibility_notes: Includes reduced-motion disable; content text is isolated in high z-index landmark.

patterns.name: Bento-style hero composition
patterns.description: Hero broken into a high-density Bento grid with primary value prop, live telemetry widget, metric pill, and visual demo.
patterns.responsive_behavior: Desktop: 3-column Bento grid with 2:1 column spans; Mobile: single-column card stack.
patterns.code_snippet:
V3.2 Engine

Build Without Friction

Automate frontend design-to-code pipelines with mathematically validated tokens.

99.98% Cache Hit Ratio
npm i @ultra-uiux/core
patterns.accessibility_notes: Grid reflows cleanly; interactive elements retain logical tab order across bento boxes.

patterns.name: Side-navigation hero
patterns.description: Persistent vertical sidebar on the left with hero viewport filling the remaining canvas space.
patterns.responsive_behavior: Desktop: fixed 280px sidebar + calc(100% - 280px) hero container; Mobile: sidebar collapses to hamburger drawer.
patterns.code_snippet:
ULTRA // UX
Work About Contact

Software Engineered for Extreme Reliability

Zero unverified claims. Measurable engineering standards.
patterns.accessibility_notes: Sidebar landmark marked <aside> with <nav>; mobile drawer has accessible aria-expanded button.

patterns.name: Scrolling narrative hero
patterns.description: Sticky pinned hero where headline stays locked while narrative bullet points slide past sequentially.
patterns.responsive_behavior: Uses position: sticky with top: 20%; narrative cards trigger step visibility via IntersectionObserver.
patterns.code_snippet:
Why We Built This

Three core convictions guide every pixel we ship.

01. Speed First

Every millisecond saved is cognitive friction eliminated.

02. Zero Hallucinations

Software should state observed reality, not optimistic guesses.

03. Visual Distinctiveness

Reject the monotony of template-driven websites.
patterns.accessibility_notes: Sticky behavior disables gracefully on mobile to prevent viewport clipping.
